results.title: Application of model-based systems engineering in small satellite conceptual design-A SysML approach
results.abstract: The satellite design industry has successfully accepted systems engineering (SE) since its inception, taking advantage of its methodologies and techniques to harness underlying complexities. In traditional SE approach, it becomes difficult to assess the completeness and consistency of information spread across tools and documents.
